meta.source: Based on dool2.com (dool² wordmark, mint outlet-face mascot, black user bubble, white app on dark-navy landing).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background. Clean white in light; near-black graphite in dark (dool2.com app).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised areas: composer, approval sheet, sidebar panel. One level only.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: '두리가 보고 있는 화면' panel, agent log, selected sidebar row.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and quiet borders (1px). Prefer this to shadows.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders; meets 3:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, primary button fill, the USER's chat bubble.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, timestamps, helper text. 6:1 on bg.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill (user bubble, primary button).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand mint or butter fills, both themes.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: dool² 민트. The mascot, the ² in the wordmark, live 'working' dot/spinner. Not for text on white (2:1) and never a large UI background in the app.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Brand-colored text: '우리 집에서 일하는 중', links. 5.4:1 on bg (light), 9:1 (dark).

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the live step row, selected task, connected-device badge.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Landing hero only: the deep navy behind the phone mockup on dool2.com. Never inside the app.

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: Needs-you: approval requests, the ? badge on the asking mascot. Text on it = on-accent.

tokens.name: butter-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of an approval card header or a pending row. Text on it = ink.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, 멈추기, 거절 text. Small, never a block.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of an error notice.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring with 2px offset. Ink, not blue.

tokens.name: me
tokens.usage: My (user) bubble: soft mint. v2.

tokens.name: me-ink
tokens.usage: Text on my bubble.

tokens.name: approve
tokens.usage: The one approve button (gradient from #1aa369). v2.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Floating glass: header buttons, composer, tab bar, sheets (with backdrop blur). v2.

families.sans: "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, -apple-system, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Noto Sans KR", sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Landing hero and empty-state headline only. One per screen.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Card and section headings, approval question.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: 내일 오전 9시 서울→부산 KTX, 창가 자리로 잡아둘게요.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 쿠팡 장바구니에 3개 담았어요. 결제 전에 물어볼게요.
styles.usage: Chat messages on PC, general UI text.

styles.name: log
styles.usage: Agent action log, receipts, numbers that must align. The only place mono appears.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, dot offsets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips, between stacked meta lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between chat messages from the same speaker; list row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile screen side margin; card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between message groups; PC panel padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section gaps on PC.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Landing section rhythm; empty-state breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, small tags, log rows, checkbox.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Chat bubbles, approval sheet, composer.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom sheet top corners, app icon proportion.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Only the character, status dots and the avatar. Buttons are NOT pills.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Only floating things: approval sheet, popovers, composer on mobile. Everything else uses line.
